verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents its own recurring scheduling for specific compliance workflows: recurring schedules and reminders for user access reviews, recurring vendor reviews based on risk level, and customizable notifications for regular tasks such as quarterly access reviews and annual pen tests. These are fixed, domain-specific schedules rather than general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows, and nothing shows recurring jobs can be set up through the API or MCP. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined job/workflow scheduling, programmatic (API/MCP) schedule creation, cron-style or arbitrary recurrence configuration, independent corroboration.
